test_title: PYST 27: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 20th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct indirect speech:

She said, “I had completed the assignment.”

options.text: She said that she had completed the assignment.
She said she has completed the assignment.
She said she completed the assignment.
She said she would complete the assignment.

solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. She said that she had completed the assignment .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in **direct speech**, and we are required to convert it into **indirect speech**.
 
• The verb in the direct speech, **"had completed,"** is in the **past perfect tense**.
 
• When converting direct speech to indirect speech, the tense of the verb remains the same if the reporting verb (in this case, "said") is in the past tense.
 
• Thus, the correct conversion is: **"She said that she had completed the assignment."**

Correct sentence: *She said that she had completed the assignment.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When converting direct to indirect speech:
 
 
• If the reporting verb is in the past tense, the verb in the reported speech is shifted one step back in tense.
 
• For example:
 
 
• **Direct Speech:** She said, "I am happy."
 
• **Indirect Speech:** She said that she was happy.
 
 
 
 
 
• In this case, since the verb in the direct speech is already in past perfect tense, it remains unchanged in the indirect speech.
